identification: Footed swing-handle sweet/bon-bon basket with twisted wire handle, leaf-shaped flared sides, cast scroll and rosette mounts. Foot underside stamped STERLING 925 plus a second stamp that is illegible in the photos. Not British hallmarked, so likely 20th century foreign (Mexican or American) and light, perhaps 100-200 g.

entries.note: Edwardian Sheffield-hallmarked pierced oval swing-handle basket, 362 g, 28 cm wide. Far heavier, British and antique, so not comparable to a small foreign 925 basket. Database entry only, page not opened; rate as per database.

searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'sterling basket', 'silver basket swing handle', '925 basket', 'Mexico sterling'; work/comps.py: 'sterling basket'. No direct same-item hit (no small foreign 925 swing-handle basket). Armitage 2026-03-25 sale 27485 lot 808 basket was plated, ignored.
chrome_hint: eBay AU and eBay US sold/completed: 'sterling 925 swing handle basket footed twisted handle', 'sterling silver bon bon basket twisted wire handle', 'Mexico sterling basket swing handle'; Terapeak same terms, last 90 days, note weight per sale. Also LiveAuctioneers and Invaluable results for 'sterling silver swing handle basket 925' (small, under 250 g), and Australian houses (Leski, Mossgreen, Davidson, Lawsons) for 'sterling basket'. Compare on weight, and check the scrap rate (sterling about A$1.2 to 1.5 per gram).
viewing_check: Photograph the foot stamps close up to read the second mark (maker, MEXICO, country or city) and any hallmark. Weigh the basket if allowed, as weight sets the scrap floor. Check the leaf sides for splits or repairs and that the swing handle is original and not loose.
rate_note: All database prices taken as AUD as printed by comps.py (foreign sales already converted by the database; rate not shown). Estimate for expected value: a light foreign 925 basket is mostly weight and decor value, plausibly A$60-150, no SOLD comp confirms this.
